data.title: Playground Shadow Safari
data.description: Explore the sunny playground and discover how our friendly stick figure's shadow changes from morning to afternoon!

challenges.instruction: Drag the sun to the 8:00 AM mark and look closely at Sammy's shadow. What do you notice about its direction and length?
challenges.hint: When the sun is low in the morning sky, check which side of Sammy the shadow falls on!

challenges.instruction: Now, drag the sun to the 12:00 PM midday mark. What happens to Sammy's shadow when the sun is way up high?
challenges.hint: Think about where the sun shines from at noon. Is the shadow big or small?

challenges.instruction: Finally, drag the sun to the 4:00 PM afternoon mark. How has Sammy's shadow changed compared to the morning?
challenges.hint: In the afternoon, the sun moves over to the other side of the sky. Where does the shadow point now?
